This is a self-declaration only. note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs records; registered address per ImportKey: "9B DR. MARTIN LUTHER KING SARANI" (site: 2nd Floor, 9B, Wood St, Mullick Bazar, Park Street area, Kolkata 700016), consistent. HS discrepancy: declared HS 732599 (other cast iron/steel articles) does NOT match the observed shipment HS codes — all four visible export rows are 39269099 (other articles of plastics), and the goods are PTFE/graphite/plastic sealing rings and packing sets. Per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground: verdict accepted_hs_corrected — actual HS to be recorded as 39269099 (plastics articles) with 732599 retained only as a secondary/legacy code if any cast-metal items are shipped. Role: manufacturer (site claims own manufacturing; customs rows show it as exporter/supplier and also as importer of raw materials such as SGL Carbon / Shenyang Head Science, i.e. manufacturer_trader pattern). Export activity is factually confirmed by dated customs rows with destination and B/L numbers; domestic supply remains 'declared, not confirmed' — no GST turnover or tender record obtained, so revenue and domestic volume fields = null (not invented).
